content.rule: Modal Verbs for Possibility and Obligation (might, may, must, have to)

content.passage: Anwar El Kamony is an inspiring person known for his incredible journey to overcome adversity. When Anwar, a young tennis player from Egypt, was diagnosed with cancer, he faced a life-changing challenge. The news was devastating, but Anwar knew he must stay determined to fight the disease. Throughout his treatment, Anwar understood that he should stay positive and focused on his recovery. He continued to train as much as he could and stayed mentally strong by visualizing his return to the tennis court. His family and friends provided great support, helping him on his journey. After months of treatment, Anwar not only beat cancer but also returned to professional tennis. He took part in international tournaments and became a symbol of hope and strength for many.
